display.purpose: Marketing hero only, one per page.

figure.purpose: Timings, token counts, page refs, credit counts. Tabular mono.

label.purpose: Short uppercase legend above a figure or column.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Marketing scroll reveals and the hero sequence.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand); color: var(--brand-foreground); height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px var(--font-schibsted, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px var(--font-schibsted, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 4px; font: 14px var(--font-schibsted, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Citation Mark
components.description: Inline source reference in an answer; opens the source at that page.
components.css: .ds-cite { font: 500 11px var(--font-spline-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--brand); background: var(--brand-subtle); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-cite:hover { border-color: var(--brand); } .ds-cite:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Figure Row
components.description: Legend label over a mono figure; used for timings, tokens, credits.
components.css: .ds-figure { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-figure-label { font: 500 11px var(--font-spline-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-figure-value { font: 500 20px var(--font-spline-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; color: var(--foreground); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Document type or status word. Square, never a pill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font: 500 11px var(--font-spline-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted-foreground); background: var(--muted); border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 6px; }

narrative.overview: A reviewer at a desk, in daylight, with the document and a red pencil. Cool graphite paper and ink, structure drawn with hairline rules like an engineering datasheet, and a single vermilion mark only where the reviewer pointed: what you can act on, what you selected, where an answer came from. The product is the proof, so the site shows real machinery instead of describing it. Light first, dark fully supported.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color: tinted neutrals carry 90% or more of every screen; one accent, rarely.
Structure by hairline rule and whitespace, not by cards, shadows or color blocks.
Two voices of type: a grotesk for words, a mono for data.
Flat at rest; motion explains state changes and real sequence.
Real product shown close up; never an illustration standing in for it.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks what you can act on, what you selected, or where an answer came from. Otherwise it is decoration and it is removed.

rules.name: The No Raw Palette Rule
rules.body: Components never use Tailwind palette classes or hex values; only semantic tokens.

rules.name: The Mono Carries Data Rule
rules.body: Spline Sans Mono appears only on figures and legend labels.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: All words, including display, are Schibsted Grotesk. No serif, no italic display.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow; a shadow appears only on something that floats.

dos: Do spend the vermilion like a reviewer's red pencil.
Do set every number in Spline Sans Mono with tabular figures.
Do build structure with 1px hairlines and the 12-column grid.
donts: Don't use generic AI tool marketing: glow blobs, gradient text, purple or neon accents.
Don't use SaaS landing-page clichés: centered hero stack, icon-card triplets, pill badges, dot grids.
Don't use emerald, a serif display face, or raw palette classes.
Don't animate layout properties or use bounce and elastic easing.
